text.printed:
[star] You can exhaust any number of Weapon or Tech upgrades you control to generate that many [wild] resources while paying for this card.
Hero Interrupt: When an encounter card is revealed from the encounter deck, cancel all of its effects and discard it. For each upgrade you exhausted to pay for this card, deal 1 damage to an enemy or remove 1 threat from a scheme.
